eve (DevEx): Quick sync: onboarding shows confusion — SDKs don't consistently show http codes or give retry guidance.
tj (SDK): seen it. Node sometimes returns opaque errors with no http_status.
ana (PM): core rule: 401 -> refreshable, 403 -> permission denied. But users need explicit hints.
mike (eng): propose a tiny standardized envelope for API responses and SDK errors: error_type, code, message, http_status, retry_policy, hint, retry_after (opt). Keep message actionable.
tj (SDK): agree. We'll add typed errors: Node: class RedwoodError extends Error {status, code, retryPolicy, hint}. Go: interface RedwoodError {Error(); StatusCode() int; RetryPolicy() string; Code() string}.
eve (DevEx): examples in sampleapps should show "hint":"refresh token" or "hint":"request scope:inference.write" not stack dumps.
ci-bot: CI note: several sampleapp tests rely on legacy error shape.
mike (eng): compatibility plan: SDKs default to new typed errors but honor REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS=true to return old shape. We'll update sampleapps and flip default in one release.
tj (SDK): mapping rules: 401 -> retry_policy=always if refreshable=true, else none; 403 -> none; 429 -> idempotent_only + retry_after from header; 5xx -> idempotent_only.
ana (PM): add telemetry tag error_surface:v2 and migration_cohort so support metrics can track impact.
eve (DevEx): action items: @tj implement SDK classes + shim, @mike add envelope at API edge and auth normalization for expired tokens, @ana update onboarding docs and FAQ. I'll draft spec and examples.
tj (SDK): starting PR today, will include unit tests for mappings.
mike (eng): i'll schedule a small canary once PRs land.
eve (DevEx): thanks team. This should cut down support tickets and make DX parity across SDKs.
